events.name: New Orleans Saints at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: Drew Brees overcame a shaky start and threw for one touchdown and ran for another and the New Orleans Saints defeated the Carolina Panthers 28-10 Thursday night to take over first place in the NFC South.
headlines.shortLinkText: Saints top Panthers to take NFC South lead

headlines.description: Hill's 2 TD runs lead Bengals over Jaguars 33-23
headlines.shortLinkText: Hill's 2 TD runs lead Bengals over Jaguars 33-23

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: Carson Palmer had three touchdown passes after an early interception the Cowboys returned for a score, and the Dallas offense struggled without the injured Tony Romo in a 28-17 loss to Arizona on Sunday.

events.name: New York Jets at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Alex Smith leads Chiefs past Mike Vick, Jets 24-10
headlines.shortLinkText: Alex Smith leads Chiefs past Mike Vick, Jets 24-10

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: Vikings ruin RG3's return, top Redskins 29-26
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings spoil RG III return, top Redskins

headlines.description: Mark Sanchez replaced the injured Nick Foles and threw for 202 yards and two touchdowns to lead the Philadelphia Eagles to a 31-21 win over the Houston Texans on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sanchez fills in for Foles, leads Eagles to win

events.name: St. Louis Rams at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: Colin Kaepernick fumbled at the goal line with 2 seconds remaining, and St. Louis sacked the San Francisco quarterback eight times on the way to a 13-10 upset over the 49ers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kaepernick fumbles at line to hand Rams victory

events.name: Denver Broncos at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady outdueled Peyton Manning, throwing for four touchdowns, and Julian Edelman returned a punt 84 yards for a score in leading the New England Patriots past the Denver Broncos 43-21 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady bests Manning as Patriots rock Broncos

headlines.description: Lynch's 2 TDs lead Seattle past Oakland 30-24
headlines.shortLinkText: Lynch's 2 TDs lead Seattle past Oakland 30-24

headlines.description: Ben Roethlisberger threw for 340 yards and six scores to set an NFL record for most touchdown passes in consecutive games, leading the Steelers to a 43-23 victory over the Ravens on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Roethlisberger historic with 6 more TDs in rout

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at New York Giants

headlines.description: Andrew Luck threw for four touchdowns and the Colts' defense kept Eli Manning and the Giants off balance in Indianapolis' 40-24 romp.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luck's 4 TDs power resurgent Colts by Giants
